textRun.content: * Properties of Real Numbers (Commutative, Associative, Distributive, Identity, Inverse)
* Prime Factorization, Greatest Common Factor (GCF), and Least Common Multiple (LCM)
* Sequences and Series (Arithmetic, Geometric, Fibonacci, Harmonic)
* Sets and Set Notation (Unions, Intersections, Subsets, Venn Diagrams)
* Linear Equations and Inequalities (Solving and Graphing)
* Systems of Linear and Non-Linear Equations (Substitution, Elimination, Graphing)
* Types of Functions (Linear, Quadratic, Rational, Absolute Value, Exponential, Logarithmic, Piecewise)
* Word Problems (Age, Motion, Work, Mixture, Coin, and Digit problems)
* Basic Geometric Concepts (Points, Lines, Planes, Angles)
* Logic and Reasoning (Conditional Statements, Converses, Inverses, Contrapositives)
* Parallel and Perpendicular Lines (Transversals, Angle Pairs)
* Properties and Theorems (Triangle Inequality, Exterior Angle)
* Congruence Postulates (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL)
* Pythagorean Theorem and Special Right Triangles (30-60-90, 45-45-90)
* Quadrilaterals and Polygons (Properties, Interior and Exterior Angle Sums)
* Circles (Radii, Diameters, Chords, Tangents, Secants, Arcs, Sectors)
* Surface Area and Volume of 3D Solids (Prisms, Cylinders, Pyramids, Cones, Spheres)
* Equations of a Line (Slope-Intercept, Point-Slope, Standard Form)
* The Unit Circle (Exact Values of Standard Angles)
* Solving Right Triangles (Angles of Elevation and Depression)
* Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)
* Measures of Variability (Range, Variance, Standard Deviation)
* Data Analysis and Graph Interpretation (Pie charts, Bar graphs, Scatter plots)
* Basic Probability (Independent vs. Dependent Events, Mutually Exclusive Events)
* Pre-Calculus & Basic Calculus (Crucial for STEM / DOST / USTET)
* Basic Derivatives (Power Rule, Product/Quotient Rule, Chain Rule)
* Origin of the Universe and Solar System (Big Bang Theory, Nebular Hypothesis)
* Heavenly Bodies (Stars, Galaxies, Comets, Asteroids, Meteors)
* Lunar and Solar Eclipses, Phases of the Moon
* The Earth's Subsystems (Lithosphere, Hydrosphere, Atmosphere, Biosphere)
* Layers of the Earth and Composition
* Minerals and Rocks (Igneous, Sedimentary, Metamorphic, Rock Cycle)
* The Water Cycle and Basic Oceanography
* Fossils, Stratigraphy, and Geologic Time Scale
* Cell Membrane and Cellular Transport (Osmosis, Diffusion, Active Transport)
* Human Anatomy and Physiology (Digestive, Respiratory, Circulatory, Nervous, Endocrine, Skeletal, Muscular, Excretory, Reproductive, Immune systems)
* Taxonomy and Classification (Domains, Kingdoms, Binomial Nomenclature)
* Evolution (Theories of Evolution, Natural Selection, Speciation)
* Food Chains, Food Webs, and Energy Pyramids
* Mixtures and Separation Techniques (Filtration, Distillation, Chromatography)
* History of the Atom and Atomic Models
* Atomic Structure and Subatomic Particles (Protons, Neutrons, Electrons, Isotopes, Ions)
* Periodic Trends (Electronegativity, Ionization Energy, Atomic Radius, Electron Affinity)
* Chemical Bonding (Ionic, Covalent, Metallic, Lewis Structures, VSEPR Theory)
* Chemical Nomenclature (Naming Compounds and Writing Formulas)
* The Mole Concept, Molar Mass, and Avogadro's Number
* Chemical Reactions (Types of Reactions, Balancing Equations)
* Stoichiometry (Limiting/Excess Reactants, Percent Yield, Empirical/Molecular Formulas)
* Gas Laws (Boyle's, Charles's, Gay-Lussac's, Combined, Avogadro's, Ideal Gas Law)
* Solutions (Solubility, Molarity, Molality, Percent by Mass/Volume)
* Thermodynamics and Kinetics (Endothermic vs Exothermic Reactions, Catalysts)
* Basic Organic Chemistry (Hydrocarbons, Functional Groups, Naming Conventions)
* Nuclear Chemistry (Alpha, Beta, Gamma Decay, Fission vs. Fusion)
* Scalars and Vectors (Vector Addition and Resolution)
* Two-Dimensional Motion (Projectile Motion, Uniform Circular Motion)
* Force, Friction, Tension, and Normal Force
* Work, Energy, and Power (Kinetic and Potential Energy, Conservation of Energy)
* Momentum and Impulse (Conservation of Momentum, Elastic vs. Inelastic Collisions)
* Gravity and Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion
* Fluid Mechanics (Density, Pressure, Buoyancy, Archimedes' Principle, Bernoulli's Principle)
* Thermodynamics (Heat Transfer Mechanisms, Laws of Thermodynamics, Specific Heat Capacity)
* Waves and Sound (Wave Properties, Mechanical vs. Electromagnetic Waves, Doppler Effect)
* Light and Optics (Reflection, Refraction, Mirrors, Lenses, Electromagnetic Spectrum)
* Idioms and Figures of Speech / Sawikain at Tayutay
* Confusing Words (e.g., Affect vs. Effect, Its vs. It's, Nang vs. Ng, Sila vs. Sina)
* Parts of Speech / Bahagi ng Pananalita (Nouns, Pronouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Adverbs, Prepositions, Conjunctions)
* Subject-Verb Agreement / Wastong Gamit ng Salita
* Tenses and Voice of Verbs (Active vs. Passive)
* Short Stories and Excerpts from Novels
* Visual Media (Interpreting Comic Strips, Editorial Cartoons, Charts, and Graphs)
* Identifying the Main Idea / Topic Sentence / Paksa ng Talata
* Inferencing and Drawing Conclusions Distinguishing Fact from Opinion
* Identifying Author's Purpose, Tone, and Point of View
* Meaning through Context Clues (within full passages)
Reasoning (Critical for DOST, ACET, & Scholarship Exams)
* Figure Series (Predicting the next shape in a pattern)
* Figure Matrices (Completing a 2x2 or 3x3 grid of shapes)
* Mental Rotation and 3D Visualization (Unfolding cubes, shadow casting)
* Mechanical & Technical Reasoning (Highly tested in DOST)
* Gear Rotations (Predicting Clockwise vs. Counter-clockwise movement)
* Pulleys and Levers (Mechanical advantage, balance, fulcrums)
* Fluid Pressure in Pipes and Containers
* Structural Stability and Center of Gravity
